An easy coastal path. I'll check the route and the weather before promising anything.
一条轻松的海岸小路。我会先查路线和天气，再答应具体安排。
Kai
Could you put the distance in the message? Your short walk and mine may have different definitions.
消息里能写一下距离吗？你和我对走一小段的定义，可能不太一样。
Miles
And the lunch options. Evan and Oliver might be interested if we ask them.
还有午饭能吃什么。问一问的话，Evan 和 Oliver 可能也会感兴趣。
Dean
Then we'd need two cars or a train. Mine's a car, not a nightclub queue with wheels.
那就得两辆车，或者坐火车。我这是车，不是装了轮子的夜店排队通道。
Kai
Fair. No squeezing six of us in. What day were you thinking?
有道理。不能硬挤六个人。你考虑哪天？
Grant
Sunday, if the forecast holds. I like quiet places. Doesn't mean I always want to go alone.
如果天气合适，周日吧。我喜欢安静的地方，不代表我总想一个人去。
Dean
Was that a sincere invitation? Somebody write it down before he changes the subject.
这是一次真诚的邀请吗？赶紧记下来，免得他转移话题。
Miles
Accepted in principle. You're not the only person here learning to let other people join in.
原则上接受。这里又不只有你一个人在学习怎么让别人参与自己的生活。
Grant
Good. Dean, aren't you busy on Saturday anyway?
很好。Dean，你周六不是还有安排吗？
Kai
That sounds like information. Is there a date we haven't heard about?
听起来有情况。有一场我们还没听说的约会吗？
Grant
He asked me which shirt looked less like he was trying. I gave him an unhelpfully honest answer.
他问我，哪件衬衫显得没那么刻意。我给了一个诚实得帮不上忙的答案。
Dean
There might be a first drink. Could we please postpone the press conference until it actually happens?
可能会去喝第一杯。能不能等真见了面，再开新闻发布会？
Kai
Fine. Grant, send the route. I'll ask the others, and nobody puts romantic expectations in the calendar.
行。Grant 发路线，我问其他人，谁也别把恋爱预期写进日历。
Miles
Perfect. And Dean, keep the car photo. Just make sure the man gets a proper introduction too.
完美。Dean，车的照片可以留着，只是也得让照片里的男人好好介绍一下自己。

context.en: After the same Saturday brunch, Kai, Miles, Grant and Dean leave the cafe together. Dean has parked his old car nearby, and Kai recognises it from a photograph. Teasing about dating profiles turns into a possible coastal walk the following Sunday. No route, weather forecast or transport plan has been confirmed, and Evan and Oliver have not yet been invited.

label: Social English · Trial 34
title: Sunday Is Not a Fitness Test
subtitle: At a Thursday planning coffee, Evan meets Grant and Dean and discovers that the coastal walk has room for questions, snacks and a later start.
description: Four voices · first introductions · planning a day out
dialogue: Kai
Evan, this is Grant, and this is Dean. Shall we establish that Sunday is a day out, not a fitness test?
Evan，这是 Grant，这是 Dean。我们先说清楚，周日是出去玩，不是体能考试，好吗？
Evan
Lovely to meet you both. Should I be asking about the scenery or my chances of surviving the pace?
很高兴认识两位。我该问问风景，还是问自己能不能跟上你们？
Grant
The scenery. It's about six kilometres on an easy path. Nobody gets a medal for finishing first.
问风景就行。一条大约六公里的轻松路线。第一个走完也没有奖牌。
Dean
Which is disappointing. I was planning to accept mine wearing sunglasses and looking modest.
真令人失望。我本来打算戴着墨镜，一脸谦虚地领奖。
Evan
You must be the man with the car. Are we taking it, or has the group outgrown the back seat?
你一定就是有那辆车的朋友。我们坐它去，还是人已经多到后排装不下了？
Grant
If all six come, the train makes more sense. The path starts near the station.
要是六个人都来，坐火车更合理。小路起点离车站很近。
Kai
He's checked the route. I've checked whether everyone is free. Evan, have you heard from Oliver?
他查了路线，我问了大家有没有空。Evan，Oliver 回你了吗？
Dean
Before you answer, I'd like credit for not offering to squeeze everyone into a classic car.
你回答之前，我想先为自己没有提议把所有人硬塞进老车这件事邀个功。
Grant
Noted. We can save your heroic parking stories for another day.
记下了。你那些英勇的停车故事，可以留到下次。
Evan
Oliver is checking a work commitment. Miles said he'd confirm tonight. What time are we thinking?
Oliver 还在确认一个工作安排，Miles 说今晚回复。我们考虑几点出发？
Dean
After breakfast, preferably. I have a first drink on Saturday, and I'd rather not meet my alarm while still holding it.
最好吃过早饭再说。我周六有第一次约会喝酒的安排，不想手里还拿着酒杯，闹钟就响了。
Kai
Nobody's proposing dawn. Could we meet at the station after ten?
没人提议天亮就走。十点之后在车站碰头，行吗？
Evan
That sounds civilised. Is there a coffee stop, or should I negotiate one before agreeing?
听起来很文明。中间有咖啡休息吗？还是我得先谈好才答应？
Grant
There's a cafe halfway round. If the weather turns, we can take a shorter loop instead.
走到一半有家咖啡馆。天气变差的话，我们可以改走短一点的环线。
Dean
Look at him offering options. Last year his idea of flexibility was moving lunch by twelve minutes.
看看，他都开始提供选项了。去年他所谓的灵活调整，就是把午饭挪十二分钟。
Kai
Personal growth. Would you put the route in the chat so nobody turns up expecting a beach club?
这是成长。能把路线发群里吗？免得有人以为要去海滩俱乐部。
Grant
I will. Bring a layer you don't mind carrying. The forecast looks reasonable, but I'll check again on Saturday.
可以。带件方便拿着的外套。预报目前还行，不过我周六会再确认。
Evan
I can manage an extra layer. Does Dean also provide dramatic lighting for the photographs?
多带件衣服没问题。Dean 还负责给照片打戏剧性灯光吗？
Kai
Don't ask him that. We'll spend the whole day waiting for a cloud to move.
别这么问他。我们会花一整天等一朵云挪位置。
Dean
Good light takes patience. Who's in charge of the playlist?
好光线需要耐心。歌单归谁管？
Evan
We haven't even bought tickets, and you're already negotiating artistic control.
票还没买呢，你就已经在谈艺术掌控权了。
Grant
We're taking a train, not hiring a tour bus. Headphones should contain the artistic vision.
我们是坐火车，不是包旅游大巴。艺术构想可以先收在耳机里。
Dean
Fine. I'll bring snacks instead. Less controversial, and generally more popular.
行，那我带零食。争议更小，一般也更受欢迎。
Kai
Perfect. I'll send the station details once Oliver and Miles confirm. No one buys anything until then.
完美。Oliver 和 Miles 确认后，我再发车站碰头信息。在那之前大家先别买票。

context.en: On Thursday evening after the brunch where the coastal walk was suggested, Kai brings Evan to a planning coffee with Grant and Dean. This is Evan's first meeting with the two men. Grant has checked an easy route, but Oliver and Miles have not confirmed Sunday yet. The four discuss distance, transport and whether a leisurely day really needs an early start.

label: Social English · Trial 35
title: The Train Was the Sensible Option
subtitle: On Sunday morning, Miles introduces Oliver to Grant and Dean while the coffee run threatens to become the most complicated part of the journey.
description: Four voices · meeting friends · train-station banter
dialogue: Miles
Oliver, meet Grant and Dean. We've successfully assembled four adults at the correct station. Shall we celebrate quietly?
Oliver，认识一下 Grant 和 Dean。我们已经成功让四个成年人来到正确的车站。要不要低调庆祝一下？
Oliver
Lovely to meet you. Should I apologise for being the last person to confirm, or will breakfast cover it?
很高兴认识你们。我要为最后一个确认参加而道歉吗？还是请点早餐就能解决？
Grant
No apology needed. You said you'd check, then checked. That's unusually efficient for a group chat.
不用道歉。你说要确认，然后就确认了。在群聊里，这已经高效得不寻常了。
Dean
He means welcome. I'm translating until his first proper coffee.
他的意思是欢迎。在他喝到第一杯像样的咖啡之前，我负责翻译。
Oliver
Useful service. Is this the part where I discover everyone else has professional walking equipment?
服务很实用。接下来是不是该发现，其他人全都带了专业徒步装备？
Grant
I've got a waterproof and sandwiches. It isn't an expedition.
我带了防水外套和三明治。又不是去探险。
Miles
Excellent. The train was definitely the sensible option. Has anyone checked the return journey?
很好。坐火车绝对是明智选择。有人看过回程了吗？
Dean
Grant has. He sent me the options before I'd finished asking the question.
Grant 看过。我问题还没问完，他就把几个方案发来了。
Grant
I've saved them on my phone. And this isn't a secret inspection of anybody's walking speed.
我存在手机里了。另外，这不是对各位走路速度的秘密考核。
Oliver
Reassuring. Is that folded paper also a map?
令人安心。那张折起来的纸也是地图吗？
Dean
Backup. He says it doesn't need charging. I think he's becoming emotionally attached to it.
备用的。他说纸不需要充电。我觉得他都快对它产生感情了。
Miles
Speaking of backup, how long have Kai and Evan been buying six coffees?
说到备用方案，Kai 和 Evan 买六杯咖啡已经买多久了？
Oliver
Long enough for Evan to offer a detailed comparison of the cup sizes. I should probably check on them.
久到 Evan 已经有时间详细比较杯子的大小了。我大概该过去看看。
Grant
They're walking back now. Please tell them I didn't order anything involving syrup.
他们正在往回走。拜托告诉他们，我没点任何加糖浆的东西。
Dean
Nobody would dare. Your coffee order has the tone of a planning regulation.
没人敢。你的咖啡点单，听起来像一条规划条例。
Miles
What's in your bag, then, Dean? It looks suspiciously like a second breakfast.
那 Dean，你袋子里是什么？看着可疑得像第二顿早餐。
Grant
Pastries. He bought them on the way, then announced they were emergency supplies.
糕点。他路上买的，然后宣布这是应急物资。
Oliver
That improves my opinion of the emergency. Are we allowed one before departure?
这让我对这场紧急情况更有好感了。出发前能吃一个吗？
Miles
Only if we leave something for the two men currently transporting our entire coffee budget.
可以，只要给那两位正搬运我们全部咖啡预算的男人留一点。
Dean
Of course. I only demand that nobody photographs me halfway through chewing.
当然。我唯一的要求，就是别在我嚼到一半时拍照。
Oliver
Agreed. I prefer my first group photograph to contain recognisable facial expressions.
同意。我希望第一次集体照里，大家的表情至少能看懂。
Grant
Good. I'll hold the bag while you sort the coffees. Who's got the tickets ready?
很好。你们分咖啡，我来拿袋子。谁已经把票准备好了？
Dean
Mine's downloaded. Shall we move away from the stairs before we become a coffee-based obstacle?
我的下载好了。要不要离楼梯远一点？免得我们变成一座咖啡路障。
Miles
Let's. We can introduce the pastries to Evan and Kai on the train.
走吧。糕点和 Evan、Kai 的正式介绍，可以上车再进行。

context.en: By Saturday evening, Oliver and Miles have confirmed, and the six friends have chosen to travel by train. On Sunday morning they meet at the station. While Evan and Kai collect the coffees, Miles introduces Oliver to Grant and Dean for the first time. The tickets and return options are ready, although breakfast is taking on a life of its own.

label: Social English · Trial 36
title: A Good Photo, Not a Relationship Announcement
subtitle: At the coastal cafe, four familiar friends negotiate a photograph, a borrowed scarf and how much information belongs in the group chat.
description: Four voices · seaside flirting · photos and everyday intimacy
dialogue: Evan
Could someone take a photo of us before the wind turns my hair into a public statement?
有人能先给我们拍张照吗？赶在风把我的头发吹成某种公开宣言之前。
Oliver
Too late. Your hair has already expressed several strong opinions about the coast.
晚了。你的头发已经对这片海岸发表了好几个强烈观点。
Miles
I'll take it. Do you want the sea behind you, or is this mostly about documenting the scarf?
我来拍。你们想让海出现在身后，还是主要为了记录这条围巾？
Kai
The scarf is Oliver's. Evan has been wearing it since the first breeze. Should we notify its owner?
围巾是 Oliver 的。第一阵风吹来后就一直在 Evan 身上。需要通知失主吗？
Oliver
The owner offered it. Apparently lending clothes is my main contribution to this relationship.
是失主主动借的。看来借衣服已经成了我在这段相处中的主要贡献。
Miles
A generous contribution. Could you both look this way rather than argue with the knitwear?
很慷慨的贡献。你们能看这里吗？先别跟针织物吵架了。
Evan
Are we smiling normally, or pretending we don't know each other for artistic reasons?
我们正常笑，还是出于艺术考虑假装不认识？
Kai
You could try looking at each other. You've been doing it quite successfully without instructions.
你们可以试试互相看。没人指导的时候，你们一直做得挺成功的。
Miles
That one works. Want to see it before I send it?
这张不错。发给你们之前，想先看看吗？
Oliver
Please. I'd like proof that I possess a chin when the camera isn't below the table.
想。我希望证明一下，只要镜头不放在桌子底下，我也是有下巴的人。
Kai
You both look good. Are we expecting an acceptance speech?
你们都很好看。接下来有获奖感言吗？
Evan
Just send it to us first. I'd rather enjoy the day than write a caption for everyone I know.
先发给我们就好。我更想享受今天，不想给所有认识的人写配文。
Oliver
Agreed. A good photograph doesn't have to announce anything. Although I am rather pleased with that one.
同意。一张好照片不一定非得宣布什么。不过这张我确实挺喜欢。
Miles
Sent to you both. Shall we get a ridiculous one as well, so this doesn't become too tasteful?
分别发给你们了。要不要再拍张傻一点的，免得整件事太有品位？
Kai
Finally, a brief I can deliver. Evan, stop looking as though you're about to explain the quarterly figures.
终于有个我能执行的拍摄要求了。Evan，别一脸准备讲季度数据的样子。
Evan
I'm trying to look relaxed. Why does that apparently require so much concentration?
我在努力显得放松。为什么这件事好像还需要高度集中注意力？
Miles
Because you've turned relaxing into a task. There. That laugh was much better.
因为你把放松也变成任务了。对，刚才那个笑就好多了。
Oliver
Keep that one. It's much more like you. Can we send it to Grant and Dean too?
那张留着。更像平常的你。也能发给 Grant 和 Dean 吗？
Evan
Yes. Now we need a picture with all six, once they return from the counter.
可以。等他们从柜台回来，我们还得拍张六个人一起的。
Kai
Give them a minute. Dean is apparently discussing cake lighting rather than simply choosing cake.
给他们一点时间。Dean 好像在讨论蛋糕的灯光，而不只是挑蛋糕。
Oliver
A serious professional. Miles, are you practising cake selection for your next dinner date?
很有职业精神。Miles，你是在为下次晚餐约会练习选蛋糕吗？
Miles
Tuesday at mine. I'm cooking, and dessert is still an unresolved strategic issue.
周二来我家。我做饭，甜点目前还是一个没解决的战略问题。
Kai
Buy something lovely. Being interested doesn't require opening a bakery. Is that rain on your sleeve?
买份好吃的吧。喜欢一个人，不代表还得开家面包店。你袖子上那个是雨点吗？
Evan
It is. Let's move inside before our windswept photograph becomes a rescue documentary.
是。进去吧，别让迎风拍照变成救援纪录片。

context.en: Later that Sunday, all six have reached the coastal cafe after the first part of the walk. Grant and Dean are choosing food at the counter while Evan, Oliver, Miles and Kai sit outside. Evan has borrowed Oliver's scarf and asks for a photograph. The conversation moves from flattering camera angles to how much of an ordinary happy moment needs to be shared.

label: Social English · Trial 37
title: The Shorter Route Still Counts
subtitle: Sheltering from a shower, Grant lets the group change the plan while Dean finally shares a little about Saturday's first drink.
description: Four voices · changing plans · first-date nerves
dialogue: Grant
The shorter loop would bring us back to the station without the exposed stretch. How does that sound?
短环线可以绕开那段无遮挡的路，直接回车站。你们觉得怎么样？
Dean
As a man who has discovered a roof and a cake menu, I'm surprisingly open to a shorter walk.
作为一个刚刚发现屋顶和蛋糕菜单的男人，我对缩短路程出奇地开放。
Miles
Sounds good to me. Are you disappointed, Grant, or relieved you won't have to listen to us complain?
我觉得很好。Grant，你是有点失望，还是庆幸不用听我们抱怨了？
Kai
I've already complained once about wet socks. I don't want to repeat myself artistically.
我已经抱怨过一次湿袜子了。不想再进行艺术性重复。
Dean
At least I chose a more practical outfit today. Yesterday's shirt was mostly selected for sitting attractively.
至少我今天穿得更实用。昨天那件衬衫，主要是为了坐着好看才选的。
Miles
That sounds like our postponed press conference. How did the first drink go?
听起来是我们推迟的新闻发布会终于开始了。第一次喝酒见面怎么样？
Grant
You can say you enjoyed it without giving a full report on the parking.
你可以直接说玩得开心，不用先完整汇报停车经过。
Kai
Was he interesting, or did you spend the evening explaining why your car has a personality?
他有意思吗？还是你花了一整晚解释，为什么你的车有独立人格？
Miles
Give him a chance. He's only just admitted that the shirt was deliberate.
给他点机会。他刚承认衬衫是特意选的。
Dean
He was interesting. He asked what I enjoy about my work, then actually listened to the answer.
他挺有意思的。他问我喜欢自己工作中的什么，而且真的听了回答。
Kai
Promising. Did you manage to stop making jokes for five consecutive minutes?
开头不错。你有成功连续五分钟不讲笑话吗？
Grant
That's ambitious. Start with two and build gradually.
目标有点高。先从两分钟开始，循序渐进。
Dean
I was nervous. I eventually said so. He smiled, asked if he could kiss me, and considerably improved the evening.
我当时紧张。后来还是说出来了。他笑了，问能不能亲我，让那个晚上好上了不少。
Miles
There we are. Was admitting it easier than trying to look completely unbothered?
这不就好了。承认紧张，是不是比努力装得毫不在意轻松？
Kai
Let the record show that good lighting wasn't the decisive factor.
请记录在案：好灯光并不是决定性因素。
Grant
A useful finding. And for the record, I don't mind changing the walk. I wanted the company more than the distance.
这是个有用的发现。也声明一下，我不介意改路线。我想要的是有人一起走，不是凑够公里数。
Miles
Good. We came to spend time together, not validate a route. Has the rain eased at all?
很好。我们是来相处的，不是来验收路线的。雨有没有小一点？
Dean
A little. And there's a message asking whether I'd like to meet again. I'm trying not to compose a speech.
小了一点。还有条消息问我想不想再见。我正努力不把回复写成演讲。
Grant
Would you like to? That seems a useful place to start.
你想吗？从这个问题开始，好像挺有用。
Kai
Then answer that question, not the imaginary panel reviewing your punctuation.
那就回答这个问题，别回答你脑补出来的标点审核委员会。
Dean
I've said I'd love to. The time isn't settled. Phone away before any of you start choosing wedding music.
我说了很愿意。时间还没定。先收手机，免得你们开始选婚礼音乐。
Miles
No weddings. My immediate romantic ambition is getting through Tuesday dinner without burning the kitchen.
没有婚礼。我眼下的恋爱抱负，就是周二那顿饭别把厨房烧了。
Kai
A manageable goal. I'll take the drinks to the other table. Grant, can you sit down and let someone else carry something?
目标可以实现。我把饮料送到另一桌。Grant，你能坐一会儿，让别人也搬点东西吗？
Grant
All right. Tea for me, please. Apparently organising a walk doesn't mean I have to carry every tray.
好吧。给我茶就好。看来组织一次散步，不代表每个托盘都得我来端。

context.en: A shower sends everyone inside the same cafe. Evan and Oliver settle at a nearby table while Grant, Dean, Miles and Kai discuss the shorter route Grant mentioned during planning. Dean's Saturday first drink has now happened, and he is willing to share a little about it. The day out is still underway; the group has not yet completed the walk or returned home.
